5. After we have the 4 redstone lamps, we can craft 1 observer using 1 quartz, 2 redstone, and 6 cobblestone.
6. For the 2 redstone required for the observer, we can craft 1 repeater, which requires 2 redstones.
7. To get the remaining 4 redstones, we will need to craft enough redstone torches to gather 4 redstones again. We can craft 1 repeater, which requires 2 redstones, so we already have 2 redstones.
8. Since we already have 2 redstones, we now need 2 more redstones. We can craft 1 redstone lamp, which requires 4 redstones, but we only need 2. So, we'll craft 1 redstone torch, which requires 1 redstone.
9. With the 1 redstone torch and 1 redstone, we can craft 1 redstone lamp using 4 redstone blocks. This gives us the additional 2 redstones we need.
10. Now that we have the 6 cobblestone required for the observer, we can proceed with crafting the observer.
11. Finally, we can craft the rest of the cobblestone stairs and mossy cobblestone to have 6 cobblestone total.
